content.description: A Project Manager plans, coordinates, and delivers projects on time, within budget, and to the agreed scope — building the project plan, assembling and directing the team, managing risk and dependencies, and acting as the main point of contact for clients and stakeholders. In Vietnam's IT/outsourcing sector this often includes running Agile/Scrum ceremonies, tracking sprint or milestone progress in tools like Jira, and translating client requirements into a delivery plan that developers and QA can execute against. Unlike a Product Manager, who owns the product vision and decides what should be built, a Project Manager focuses on how and when it gets delivered. Unlike a Tech Lead, who owns technical architecture decisions, a Project Manager owns schedule, budget, scope, and stakeholder relationships — technical depth helps but is not the core of the role.

vnMarket.value: Project Leader/Project Manager là một trong các vị trí quản lý có mức lương trung vị cao nhất trong ngành CNTT tại Việt Nam (ngang với Product Owner/Product Manager). Theo ITviec IT Salary & Recruitment Market Report 2025-2026, thị trường tuyển dụng IT nói chung đang cho thấy tín hiệu phục hồi, với nhiều vị trí quản lý dần lấy lại đà tuyển dụng sau giai đoạn thị trường chững lại.

salary.value: Mức lương trung vị của Project Leader/Project Manager tại Việt Nam là khoảng 50,1 triệu VNĐ/tháng theo khảo sát chung; chia theo kinh nghiệm: dưới 1 năm ~17,2 triệu, 1-2 năm ~29,85 triệu, 3-4 năm ~48,4 triệu, 5-8 năm ~58,45 triệu VNĐ/tháng (báo cáo không công bố số liệu riêng cho mốc trên 8 năm) — theo ITviec IT Salary & Recruitment Market Report 2025-2026.

demand.value: VietnamWorks hiện có hơn 660 việc làm Project Manager đang tuyển (ghi nhận 662 vị trí tại thời điểm truy cập 17/09/2026), cho thấy nhu cầu tuyển dụng vị trí này tại Việt Nam vẫn ở mức cao và liên tục.

similarJobs.name: Product Manager
similarJobs.distinction: Owns the product vision, roadmap, and decisions about what to build, rather than the schedule, budget, and delivery execution of a specific project.

similarJobs.name: Business Analyst
similarJobs.distinction: Gathers, documents, and validates business requirements rather than managing the team, timeline, budget, and risk needed to deliver those requirements.

similarJobs.name: Scrum Master
similarJobs.distinction: Facilitates Agile ceremonies and removes team-level blockers rather than owning overall project scope, budget, and client/stakeholder relationships.

similarJobs.name: Program Manager
similarJobs.distinction: Oversees a portfolio of related projects and their interdependencies, rather than the day-to-day execution of a single project.

hardSkills.name: Project planning & scheduling
hardSkills.description: Building work breakdown structures, Gantt charts, and milestone plans that define how and when a project will be delivered.

hardSkills.name: Agile/Scrum & Waterfall methodologies
hardSkills.description: Vietnamese IT teams commonly run Agile/Scrum for product delivery, though Waterfall is still used for fixed-scope client contracts; PMs need fluency in both.

hardSkills.name: Budget & resource management
hardSkills.description: Tracking project costs against budget and allocating people and time across competing priorities.

hardSkills.name: Risk & issue management
hardSkills.description: Identifying, tracking, and mitigating risks before they become blockers that threaten scope, timeline, or budget.

hardSkills.name: Project management tooling (Jira, MS Project, Trello/Asana)
hardSkills.description: Day-to-day tracking of tasks, sprints, and progress happens in these tools, which also feed status reporting to stakeholders.

hardSkills.name: Requirements & scope management
hardSkills.description: Translating client or business requirements into a clear, trackable scope, and controlling scope creep as the project evolves.

hardSkills.name: Stakeholder reporting & documentation
hardSkills.description: Producing status reports, risk logs, and project documentation that keep clients, sponsors, and internal leadership aligned.

softSkills.name: Stakeholder communication
softSkills.description: Translating technical progress and blockers into terms that clients, sponsors, and non-technical stakeholders can act on.

softSkills.name: Leadership & team motivation
softSkills.description: Keeping a cross-functional team (developers, QA, designers) focused and motivated without formal authority over their performance reviews in many org structures.

softSkills.name: Negotiation & conflict resolution
softSkills.description: Balancing competing demands from clients, management, and the delivery team, and resolving disagreements over scope, timeline, or priorities.

softSkills.name: Problem-solving under pressure
softSkills.description: Projects rarely go exactly to plan; PMs need to adapt the plan quickly when risks materialize close to a deadline.

softSkills.name: Time management & prioritization
softSkills.description: Running multiple workstreams or projects at once requires disciplined prioritization of where attention goes each day.

keySkills: Supporting a senior PM on status reporting
Scope tracking on a single workstream

salaryRange.value: ~58,45 triệu VNĐ/tháng (5-8 năm kinh nghiệm; báo cáo không công bố số liệu riêng cho mốc trên 8 năm)
